instruction: Please configure Chrome to open a new tab page every time I start the browser, instead of continuing where I left off.

metadata.explanation: This task requires configuring Chrome's startup behavior to open a new tab page. The evaluator uses the existing get_new_startup_page getter function which reads Chrome's Preferences file and checks if 'session.restore_on_startup' is set to 5 (which represents 'Open the New Tab page') or if the session key is missing (fresh-start mode). The expected value is 'true' indicating the new tab page startup mode should be enabled. Similar to the original task, this requires navigating Chrome settings (Settings > On startup > Open the New Tab page) and is of similar difficulty level.
metadata.similarity_to_original: high - both tasks involve configuring Chrome behavior settings through the settings interface

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement: the getter reads Chrome's Preferences file and checks for 'session.restore_on_startup == 5' (New Tab page mode) or missing 'session' key (fresh-start mode)
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to allow the startup setting to take effect, which is essential for verifying startup behavior
Expected value 'true' is semantically correct and matches the getter's return format
Metric (exact_match) correctly compares the string result with expected value
Complete coverage: the evaluator fully verifies that Chrome is configured to open new tab page on startup
